children.text: Students are first invited to submit their applications on the prescribed form. A committee, constituted by the Vice Chancellor, then reviews and evaluates these applications following a defined procedure. Based on the committee’s recommendations, the Vice Chancellor grants approval, after which the students receive their payments.

basicDetails.schemeName: Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)

children.text: The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. Agriculture program (all disciplines) at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar.
The fellowship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture across all disciplines by awarding a monthly fellowship of ₹1,200/- for one year.

children.text: The “Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)” scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar, under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture across all disciplines by awarding a monthly fellowship for one year.
